title: Claim
description: One statement from one page of one report, with the exact quote that supports it. The same format for every track: an agent proposes claims, code checks them, and code compares them across sources.

field.description: Property-evaluation field or part, such as location or drilling_2022.intervals.

value.description: Exactly as written on the page. An interval is an object. A statement or caveat may be null.

grades.description: Element and unit as the key, the grade as written as the value, for example {"Cu (%)": "0.30"}.

censored.description: True for a value below detection such as <10. The value stays as written; it never becomes 0.

value_norm.description: Added by code for comparisons only. Never shown in place of the value.

page.description: PDF page number, not the printed page number.

quote.description: Copied from the cited page, one contiguous span.

caveats.description: Ids of caveat claims attached by rule.

by.description: A claim on a scanned page is checked against the page image and never counts as code-checked.

also_in.description: Other pages with the exact same normalized quote. Information only.
